## FLORIDA POLICE CHIEFS ASSOCIATION ANNOUNCES ENDORSEMENT OF SENATOR ASHLEY MOODY
ORLANDO, Fla. — The Florida Police Chiefs Association has announced their endorsement of Senator Ashley Moody, the latest law enforcement organization to back her U.S. Senate campaign. The endorsement reflects Senator Moody’s proven record standing with the men and women who put their lives on the line to protect Florida families from her time as Attorney General through her work […]
ORLANDO, Fla. — The Florida Police Chiefs Association has announced their endorsement of Senator Ashley Moody, the latest law enforcement organization to back her U.S. Senate campaign. The endorsement reflects Senator Moody’s proven record standing with the men and women who put their lives on the line to protect Florida families from her time as Attorney General through her work in the U.S. Senate.
This endorsement builds on Senator Moody’s long-standing record of support for law enforcement. She has earned the endorsement of 64 county Sheriffs – Republicans and Democrats – all 15 Republican State Attorneys, the FL Police Benevolent Association, and the FL State Fraternal Order of Police.
Senator Ashley Moody said, “I am honored to have earned the support of the Florida Police Chiefs Association. Standing with the men and women who put on the badge every day to keep our communities safe isn’t new for me – I stood up for them as Florida’s Attorney General, and I’m continuing that effort now as your U.S. Senator. Florida’s law enforcement community can always count on me.”
FPCA President David Currey said, “Every chief in this association goes home at night thinking about one thing: making sure their officers get home too. Resourced properly. Supported mentally and physically. Treated with the dignity this job demands. Ashley Moody thinks about that too, not just as a senator, but as a law enforcement spouse. She gets it in a way that very few people in public life truly do.”
FPCA Immediate Past President Robert Bage said, “The Florida Police Chiefs Association is proud to endorse Ashley Moody for the United States Senate. Ashley has stood with law enforcement at every level, in every role she has held. She understands this community not just as a policy matter, but personally and deeply, as someone who is part of it. There is no stronger advocate for the men and women who serve, and there is no one more deserving of our full and enthusiastic support.”
FPCA 2nd Vice President John Barkley said, “Florida’s law enforcement community has a long memory and a deep sense of loyalty. Ashley Moody has been with us through some of the most challenging years this profession has faced. She has never waved, never walked away, and never stopped fighting for the people who keep our communities safe. We are proud to stand with her again.”
FPCA Executive Director, Jennifer “Cookie” Pritt said, “The FPCA’s endorsement reflects the breadth and depth of Ashley Moody’s ties to Florida’s law enforcement community, ties that have been forged not through politics, but through presence, consistency, and genuine relationship. She has shown up when it mattered. She has fought for funding, for mental health resources, and for the policies that keep officerssafe and communities protected. The Florida Police Chiefs Association is proud to call Ashley Moody a trusted partner, a proven leader, and a friend to every officer in the state.”

## Florida State Fraternal Order of Police Endorses Ashley Moody for U.S. Senate
The Florida State Fraternal Order of Police announced its support for Senator Ashley Moody in her campaign to return to the U.S. Senate.
TAMPA, Fla. – In case you missed it, the Florida State Fraternal Order of Police announced their endorsement of Senator Ashley Moody in her campaign to return to the U.S. Senate. The Florida State Fraternal Order of Police proudly represents over 24,000 law enforcement officers across the state.
Senator Ashley Moody said, “The Sunshine State’s law enforcement officers are the best in the business of keeping Florida families protected, and I am honored to have the endorsement of the Florida State Fraternal Order of Police as I work to continue to serve in the U.S. Senate. As your Senator, just as when I was your Attorney General, I am committed to policies that promote law and order, and ensure our brave men and women in uniform are supported. Other states want to defund police, but in Florida we defend them, and that is a fight I will never back down from.”
Shawn Dunlap, President of the Florida Fraternal Order of Police , said, “Senator Moody has proven time and again that she is an ally to law enforcement officers, as a leader guided by principle, and an unwavering advocate for the men and women who serve and protect our communities every day. Her consistent record of standing up for victims, supporting strong criminal justice policy, and defending the rule of law makes her one of our most trusted and respected voices in Washington… Senator Moody’s record is one of action and principle. When others hesitated, she led – ensuring law enforcement had the support and resources needed to protect Florida’s families.”
In July, Senator Moody earned the “complete and total endorsement” from President Donald J. Trump. Additionally, earlier this year she announced the endorsement of 64 Sheriffs and all 15 Republican State Attorneys throughout Florida. See more HERE.
The first bill Senator Moody introduced after being sworn into the United States Senate was the HELPER Act to make home ownership for law enforcement more attainable. Senator Moody believes that Florida heroes should be able to live and own a home in the communities they keep protected, and she will continue fighting to make the bipartisan HELPER Act law.
About Ashley Moody
Ashley Moody is a fifth-generation Floridian raised in Plant City, Florida, known as the Winter Strawberry Capital of the World. She is a three-time graduate of the University of Florida where she earned her bachelor’s, master’s and law degrees. She also earned her Master of Laws from Stetson University.
Raised in a family dedicated to serving others, Ashley was inspired to pursue a career in justice and public service. She began her career at the law firm Holland & Knight, where she specialized in commercial litigation. Later, Ashley became a federal prosecutor in Jacksonville and Tampa, where she prosecuted cases involving drug trafficking, firearms, and fraud offenses.
In 2006, Ashley made history as the youngest judge in Florida when she was elected to serve on the Thirteenth Judicial Circuit Court in Hillsborough County at just 31 years old.
After serving as a judge for over a decade, Ashley was elected as Florida’s 38th Attorney General and quickly earned national recognition for her leadership as she championed policies to enhance public safety, strengthen law enforcement, and crack down on violent crime. Throughout her tenure as Attorney General, Ashley earned a reputation as a fierce leader in the fight against unelected bureaucrats in Washington who sought to undermine Florida’s policies. She has also been a national leader in protecting religious freedom and the sanctity of life.
During President Donald Trump’s first administration, Ashley was appointed to serve as the only Attorney General in the country as a Commissioner on the Presidential Commission on Law Enforcement and the Administration of Justice.
On January 21, 2025, Ashley was sworn into the U.S. Senate after being appointed by Governor Ron DeSantis.
As U.S. Senator, Ashley continues her mission to uphold conservative values, strengthen national security, and fight for Floridians. She is a key supporter of President Trump’s agenda and remains dedicated to America First policies that promote law and order, economic prosperity, and American sovereignty.
Ashley and her husband, Justin, a career law enforcement officer, have two sons, Brandon and Connor.

pages.title: Priorities | Ashley Moody for U.S. Senate
pages.text:
## Priorities
Finish the wall, reinstate policies that prevent illegal immigration, and crack down on human trafficking and drug smuggling. End sanctuary cities and put American workers first.
Expand America’s leadership in space exploration, national defense, and commercial spaceflight. Strengthen investments in Florida’s Space Coast and other key hubs, cut bureaucratic roadblocks, and ensure U.S. dominance in space technology.
Cut burdensome regulations, lower taxes, and bring critical manufacturing back home. Expand domestic energy production—oil, gas, nuclear, and next-generation technologies—to lower costs and make America energy independent.
Stop government overreach in education, defend free speech, gun rights, and religious liberty. Give parents more control over their children’s education and push back against radical social agendas in schools.
Balance the budget, eliminate reckless government spending, and cut foreign aid that doesn’t serve American interests. Hold Washington accountable and prioritize economic policies that put taxpayers first. Let DOGE examine every bit of our federal government.
Invest in the strongest, most advanced military in the world while avoiding endless wars. Stop funding global organizations that undermine U.S. interests and refocus national defense on protecting American borders and strategic assets.

## SEN. ASHLEY MOODY HOSTS TAMPA CAMPAIGN STOP, VOWS TO KEEP SOCIALIST ANGIE NIXON’S RADICAL AGENDA OUT OF OUR FREE STATE OF FLORIDA
TAMPA, Fla. – Yesterday, Senator Ashley Moody hosted a campaign stop in her home county of Hillsborough with Congressman Gus Bilirakis to meet with voters, highlight her work as Florida’s Fighter in the U.S. Senate, and draw a sharp contrast with her opponent, Socialist Angie Nixon – a proud, card-carrying member of the Democrat Socialists who wants to defund the police, defund […]
TAMPA, Fla. – Yesterday, Senator Ashley Moody hosted a campaign stop in her home county of Hillsborough with Congressman Gus Bilirakis to meet with voters, highlight her work as Florida’s Fighter in the U.S. Senate, and draw a sharp contrast with her opponent, Socialist Angie Nixon – a proud, card-carrying member of the Democrat Socialists who wants to defund the police, defund the military, and abolish our prisons.
Senator Ashley Moody said, “I was born and raised right here in Hillsborough, and it’s where I chose to raise my family, because there’s no better place in America to build a life than right here in Florida. That’s exactly why I will never stop fighting to keep Florida the freest state in the nation – a place built on economic freedom and safety in our communities. Meanwhile, my opponent, Angie Nixon, is a proud, self-proclaimed Democrat Socialist who wants to bring that divisive radical agenda to Florida. That’s not the Florida I grew up in, and on my watch, it never will be.”

Senator Ashley Moody said, “I want to thank Florida’s law enforcement […]
MIAMI, Fla. – Yesterday, Senator Ashley Moody joined the Miami Fraternal Order of Police, our next Lieutenant Governor Bryan Ávila, and law enforcement leaders to highlight the stark contrast between her record and her opponent, Socialist Angie Nixon – a proud, card-carrying member of the Democrat Socialists who wants to defund the police.
Senator Ashley Moody said, “I want to thank Florida’s law enforcement community for their trust and support. During my time as your Attorney General, when politicians across the country were vilifying our men and women in blue, I made it a priority to recruit officers from across America to come to Florida because we will always have their backs. I’ve taken that same mindset to the U.S. Senate and it’s why 64 Republican, Democrat, and Independent Sheriffs and every law enforcement organization across our Free State stands with us and against Socialist Angie Nixon, who will defund our police the moment she gets the chance.”
